FROM python:3.8
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure apt reliability for eval image builds
RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

# Install git for cloning
RUN command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y git)

# Dependency-manager helpers inferred from verified setup
# No extra dependency bootstrap needed

# Clone repository and checkout base commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/Yelp/dumb-init /testbed
# No base commit provided; using repository default branch HEAD

# Agent's verified setup instructions
RUN JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -lc 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential python3 python3-pip python3-dev procps xxd' && JAYINT_APT_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=$?; (apt-get clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; if [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install -r requirements-dev.txt' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN make build
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install -e .' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN cp dumb-init /usr/local/bin/

# Post-setup compatibility helpers inferred from verified setup
# No post-setup compatibility helpers needed

build_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential python3 python3-pip python3-dev procps xxd

excluded_commands.command: cat setup.py requirements-dev.txt Makefile Dockerfile 2>&1 (read-only inspection, no state change)
cat tests/cli_test.py 2>&1 (read-only inspection, no state change)
cat tests/conftest.py 2>&1 (read-only inspection, no state change)
PATH=/app:$PATH pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings 2>&1 (test command, not a build command)

build_recipe.rationale: The build commands are derived from the successful persistent actions in the agent's trajectory. Step 2 installs required system packages for compilation and testing. Step 3 installs test dependencies. Step 4 compiles the dumb-init C binary. Step 7 installs the package in editable mode via setup.py. Step 8 copies the built binary to /usr/local/bin for system-wide access. Read-only inspection commands (steps 1, 5, 6) and the final test command (step 9) are excluded as they do not produce persistent environment changes or are test verification commands.
